mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25% and UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During housing booms (HOUST > 2200), strong housing activity signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST exceeds 2200, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.3%, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST and INDPRO both rise by more than 0.5% in the same month, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During supply booms (INDPRO > 120), strong industrial production signals robust economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO exceeds 120, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
